🇵🇰 Pakistan Country-Specific Guidance:

Curriculum Conversion: Get IBCC Equivalence for O/A-Levels or attested Matric/F.Sc marksheets. Convert grades with official school profile explaining Pakistan grading scale (80%+ is A1). (Matric / F.Sc / A-Levels)

1. SAT Math & Desmos Calculator Mastery

  • Drill daily on Khan Academy Digital SAT Math: Heart of Algebra, Advanced Math, Problem Solving, and Geometry.
  • Master Desmos shortcuts: Graphing linear and quadratic systems, finding intersection roots instantly, using table sliders, and linear regression (y1 ~ mx1 + b).
  • Aim to solve 80% of Module 2 math questions directly via Desmos speed hacks in under 45 seconds each.

2. Freelance Web Development Runway Strategy

  • Take on freelance frontend projects (React, Tailwind, landing pages, client dashboards) on Upwork, Fiverr, or direct outreach.
  • Save your revenue systematically to accumulate the required ~$2,300 upfront budget for tests, passport, SEVIS, DS-160, and one-way US airfare.
  • Keep clean records and project repositories on GitHub — this also forms your top extracurricular achievements for Common App!

Campus Arrival & Logistics Protocol

Step 5 Master Plan

Hardware Packing Protocol

Pack your high-value PC parts (GPU, NVMe SSDs, RAM sticks, CPU) strictly in your carry-on baggage inside anti-static packaging. Never put heavy computer monitors or bulky cases in checked luggage — order a cheap monitor and case on Amazon or university buy/sell groups upon arrival.

Banking: Chase or Bank of America

Within your first week, visit a local branch of Chase (College Checking) or Bank of America (Advantage Banking). Bring your Passport, Form I-20, and Student ID to establish a $0-fee account, debit card, and direct deposit for your campus job.

Campus Athletics & Wrestling Routine

US liberal arts colleges feature world-class, free athletics centers. Integrate into the wrestling club, martial arts dojo, or strength training facilities to maintain peak physical vitality and mental discipline throughout your undergraduate journey.

🛡️ All liberal arts facilities are 100% free for matriculated students.
